source_object.mechanism: A complete source carrier is reconstructed in an isolated GitHub Actions workspace, qualified, rendered into eight controlled views, and placed before an operator review board with no preselected decision.

workflow_effect: Verifies changed-path scope, validates and expands the multipart text carrier, installs an isolated browser runtime, reruns 202 source-carrier checks, 75 runtime checks, and 15 operator-console checks, then retains the measured review artifact. It writes no repository file and deploys nothing.

evidence_ledger.venue: draft pull request and isolated GitHub Actions runner
evidence_ledger.target: Useful Plant v30 source-native vertical slice
evidence_ledger.upside: independent reproducibility and operator-visible review surface
evidence_ledger.downside: exact inherited parent and exact retained Plant media remain unmounted
evidence_ledger.failure_mode: treating reconstructed or generated evidence as exact parent custody, retained-media identity, operator acceptance, or release authority

blocking_holds: exact retained Plant origin SVG not mounted
exact retained cached Plant WebP not mounted
Household, Street, and Property rendered parent locks not executed against exact v29 bytes
